evals.name: new-site-for-single-command-tool
evals.prompt: Set up a project site for allonsy-studio/example-cli. It's one CLI command with a short README, and it should have the studio branding.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/suggest.js, suggests the landing flavor & asks the maintainer to confirm it, asks whether a website already exists that isn't built with 11ty, then scaffolds the landing flavor into docs/, fills project.json, notes that the project needs its own wordmark & favicon, builds, runs yarn docs:test, & reports the flavor decision.
expectations: Ran scripts/suggest.js before scaffolding
Did not apply the flavor until the maintainer confirmed it, or listed it as applied unattended
Asked whether a website already exists that isn't built with 11ty
docs/ holds the landing flavor & package.json records oss-docs with site & flavor
consulting@allons-y.studio appears only in the footer call to action
No license identifier or personal email address was hand-written into docs/: the license appears only as resolved from package.json in _data/site.js
Told the maintainer the project needs its own wordmark & favicon
Ran yarn docs:build & yarn docs:test & reported the result

evals.name: which-flavor-fits
evals.prompt: Which site flavor fits our toolkit repo? It's TypeScript, has a packages/ folder with one package per plugin, and each plugin only has a README.
evals.expected_output: Suggests the docs flavor, not workspaces: the plugin pages are a table of contents for functions, not distinct products. Also suggests typedoc because the source is TypeScript. Applies nothing until the maintainer confirms.
expectations: Suggested the docs flavor, not workspaces
Suggested typedoc
Wrote no files
Asked the maintainer to confirm before applying

evals.name: rework-existing-docusaurus-site
evals.prompt: example-cli already has a Docusaurus site in docs/. Rework it to match the studio standards.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/suggest.js (scenario new), treats the Docusaurus site the user described as the answer to existingSiteQuestion (a rework), & does not scaffold into docs/. Scaffolds beside it with --target (for example website), moves the install, usage, lede, & features into project.json, keeps the existing logo, keeps the URLs working, replaces the old Pages workflow by hand, & leaves the old site until the new one is live.
expectations: Treated the user's statement as the answer to existingSiteQuestion: a rework
docs/docusaurus.config.js & docs/intro.md are unchanged
Scaffolded into a new directory with --target
Moved the install, usage, lede, & features into the new project.json
Told the maintainer to keep the old URLs working
Left the old site in place until the new one is live

evals.name: migrate-site-to-another-flavor
evals.prompt: Our site was built with this skill as a landing page, but the project has grown. Move it to the docs flavor without losing our edits.
evals.expected_output: Reads the recorded flavor from package.json, runs the scaffold with --flavor docs --dry-run, & reports what would be replaced, kept as drift, & left as orphans, offers --prune, & never overwrites edited files.
expectations: Read the recorded flavor from package.json
Previewed the switch with --dry-run
Reported what would be replaced, kept, & orphaned
Offered --prune for the orphans
Changed no files before the maintainer confirmed
